reports.title: Roivant Reports Financial Results for the Second Quarter Ended September 30, 2026, and Provides Business Update

desk.headline: Revenue $35.1m on first LISRAYA sales, far above estimate; loss narrows; no financial guidance
results: First product sales: LISRAYA (brepocitinib) brought in $31.0m in its first five weeks after US approval in August; total revenue was $35.1m vs $1.6m a year ago.
Loss from continuing operations narrowed to $153.0m from $166.0m as R&D fell 11% to $145.7m; SG&A rose 8% to $154.1m on launch spending.
Net loss per share widened to $0.27 from $0.17, including about $0.13 a share tied to distributions linked to the Moderna settlement proceeds.
Cash and marketable securities of $4.2bn after the $950m initial Moderna payment in July; $72.5m spent buying back 2.1m shares in the quarter.
Pipeline: IMVT-1402 600 mg met its main goal in difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis (300 mg did not); brepocitinib won both Phase 3 uveitis trials; mosliciguat Phase 3 started.

guidance.summary: Roivant gives no revenue or earnings guidance. It points to milestones instead: a uveitis filing for brepocitinib in the first half of 2027, FDA talks on IMVT-1402 in RA, and an Investor Day on 9 December.

points: Management said early patient and prescriber feedback on LISRAYA is strong, with payer access mostly smooth but some plans harder.
It warned that pharmacy stocking effects should be a modest drag on revenue in the December quarter.
On IMVT-1402 in RA, it tied the 600 mg success and 300 mg miss to deeper antibody (IgG) suppression and expects clarity on the FDA path around year-end.
It sounded keen on the uveitis opportunity for brepocitinib and on widening mosliciguat into more lung diseases.
Sjogren's disease work with IMVT-1402 is unlikely to go beyond the current Phase 2 trial.
call.source: Roivant Sciences (ROIV) Q2 2026 earnings call transcript — The Motley Fool, 9 Nov 2026

watch: LISRAYA sales in the December quarter, given the expected stocking drag
Outcome of FDA talks on the IMVT-1402 rheumatoid arthritis programme and Investor Day details on 9 December
